I used to be a consultant at PwC. This is the whole invoice workflow:
Gmail trigger → AI extract → Google Sheets → Slack.
Ask the AI step for JSON, not a paragraph, and every field drops straight into your sheet.
Build it once and the rest are copy and tweak: receipts, supplier forms, contract emails.

n8n: https://n8n.io
Google Sheets: https://sheets.google.com
Slack: https://slack.com

Want the workflow? Comment INVOICE and I'll send you the n8n template.
Got a boring task? Comment it for the next episode.
